name: Lock
overview: Scripture presents locks as practical instruments for securing and protecting spaces, as seen in Judges 3 where doors are locked to confine and conceal events within a private chamber. The narrative highlights the importance of locking doors for safety and privacy, as the servants recognize the locked door signaling something unusual. In Nehemiah 3, the construction and repair of gates with doors, locks, and bars emphasize the role of locks in preserving the security and integrity of the city, underscoring their value in maintaining order and protection for the community.
